segments.name: U.S. dialysis
segments.description: Provides kidney dialysis and related laboratory services to patients with end stage kidney disease at outpatient centers, at home and in hospitals in the United States.
segments.evidence: Our U.S. dialysis business is a leading provider of kidney dialysis services for patients suffering from ESKD.

segments.name: Other - Ancillary services
products: integrated care and disease management services
segments.description: Combines U.S. integrated kidney care, other ancillary businesses such as clinical research and transplant software, and international dialysis operations serving patients outside the United States.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, these consisted primarily of our U.S. IKC business, certain U.S. other ancillary businesses (including our clinical research programs, transplant software business, and venture investment group), and our international operations.

revenueModel.text: Government programs such as Medicare and Medicaid, managed Medicare plans and commercial payors reimburse DaVita for dialysis treatments and related kidney care services.
revenueModel.evidence: For 2025, approximately 68% of our total U.S. dialysis patient service revenues were generated from government-based programs for services to approximately 89% of our total U.S. patients.

changes.text: In 2024 the physician services business was divested from the integrated kidney care business.
changes.evidence: partially offset by decreased revenues related to the divestiture of our physician services business in 2024.

changes.text: In 2025 revenues and costs for an internal software product were reallocated from the U.S. IKC business to the U.S. other ancillary business.
changes.evidence: In the first quarter of 2025, we reallocated the revenues and costs associated with an internal software product from the U.S. IKC business to the U.S. other ancillary business.
